# Test data sources

## `snapshots/input/*` — written for this project

All snapshot fixtures (`f77-fixed`, `legacy-f66`, `f90-modules`, `f2003-oop`, `f2008-submodules`, `cpp-include`) were
written from scratch for these tests and are covered by the repository licence (Apache-2.0). The expected output under
`snapshots/output/` is generated by the indexer (`SCIP_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 dotnet test --project tests/ScipSharp.Indexer.Fortran.Tests`)
and reviewed by hand.

## `corpus/*` — unmodified copies of permissively licensed upstream code

| Directory | Origin | Commit | Licence | Files |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `corpus/lapack` | https://github.com/Reference-LAPACK/lapack | `d74c488c1d2ea1142ab1d89bd950121cb72d9722` | BSD-3-Clause (modified BSD, `LICENSE` copied alongside) | `SRC/{dgesv,dgetf2,dgetrf,dgetrf2,dgetrs,dlaswp,ieeeck,ilaenv,iparmq,xerbla,zlatrs}.f`, `SRC/{la_constants,dlartg,dlassq}.f90`, `SRC/la_xisnan.F90`, `BLAS/SRC/{dgemm,dger,dscal,dswap,dtrsm,idamax,lsame}.f`, `BLAS/SRC/dnrm2.f90`, `INSTALL/dlamch.f` |
| `corpus/minpack` | https://github.com/fortran-lang/minpack | `c0b5aea9fcd2b83865af921a7a7e881904f8d3c2` | MIT (`LICENSE.txt` copied alongside) | `fpm.toml`, `src/minpack.f90`, `src/minpack_capi.f90`, `examples/*.f90`, `test/test_lmdif.f90` |
| `corpus/fpm` | https://github.com/fortran-lang/fpm | `ffe90aeea703820596bc58149f76f3c50a668819` | MIT (`LICENSE` copied alongside) | `fpm.toml`, `src/fpm_strings.f90`, `src/fpm_environment.f90`, `src/fpm_filesystem.F90`, `src/fpm_os.F90`, `src/fpm/error.F90` |

The corpus is used only for robustness tests (lint-clean output, resolution rate, LAPACK call graph); it has no golden
snapshots. Modules the slices `use` but that are not included (e.g. fpm's `shlex_module`, toml-f) are deliberately
left out: they exercise the unknown-module path.
